events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival 2026 (Claire Hooper & Pete Helliar highlights)
events.location: Brisbane Powerhouse, The Tivoli, Princess Theatre, Fortitude Music Hall
events.description: Brisbane Comedy Festival features a diverse lineup of festival favorites and new talent across multiple venues. This week highlights shows from Claire Hooper and Pete Helliar, offering insightful and hilarious stand-up performances.

events.title: Anywhere Festival 2026
events.description: This annual fringe festival transforms unusual Brisbane spaces into stages for nearly 300 performances. Expect experimental and immersive theatre, dance, and music in unexpected locations across the city.

events.title: Circa – Swan Lake
events.description: Circa's unique take on Swan Lake blends acrobatics, circus arts, and live music, reimagining the classic ballet with a burlesque-style black swan and a parade of human ducks. Expect an inventive and visually stunning production.

events.title: The Drover's Wife – The Opera (World Premiere)
events.description: Witness the world premiere of "The Drover's Wife – The Opera," based on Henry Lawson's iconic Australian story. This major new work offers a unique cultural experience in QPAC's new Glasshouse Theatre.

events.title: The Sapphires
events.description: This beloved musical tells the joyful and moving true story of four Aboriginal women who sing soul music for troops in Vietnam. Expect a rich theatrical experience with strong musical numbers.

events.title: Olafur Eliasson: Presence
events.description: Explore a multi-sensory exhibition by Icelandic-Danish artist Olafur Eliasson, known for immersive installations using water, light, and air temperature. Features works like Riverbed and The Cubic Structural Evolution Project, inviting interaction and contemplation.

events.title: Make A Scene
events.description: A free exhibition celebrating 90s Australian queer culture, fashion, and community, coinciding with the 35th anniversary of decriminalisation. Immerse yourself in personal stories from the underground nightclub and dance party scene.

events.title: Precious
events.description: This free exhibition at the Museum of Brisbane showcases over 3,000 unique items from local collectors, offering a charming glimpse into hidden treasures like international dolls, ornamental eggs, and wind-up toys.

events.title: Redlands Coast AdventureFest
events.description: A 10-day festival showcasing a wide variety of outdoor activities and nature experiences across the Redlands Coast. Expect kayaking, hiking, cycling, and nature tours, ideal for adventurous and nature-loving individuals.

events.title: Build with AI 3.0 – GDG Brisbane
events.description: GDG Brisbane hosts an evening diving into practical Generative AI and Data Engineering. Industry leaders will discuss ensuring reliable AI outputs and automating data mapping with serverless agents, blending strategy with hands-on learning and networking.

events.title: The Yellow Diary – Live in Brisbane
events.datetime: Fri 15 May, Doors 7:00 PM, Show 8:00 PM
events.description: Acclaimed Indian indie-pop/alternative band The Yellow Diary performs live, known for introspective lyrics and a rich, layered sound. The concert is followed by an exclusive Bollywood Club Night after-party.

events.title: Weaving is Healing Workshop
events.description: Learn the Figure 8 coil weave technique in a ceremony-style immersive sharing and healing circle. This hands-on craft workshop fosters connection and reflection in the serene setting of Mt Coot-tha Botanic Gardens.

events.title: Endless Swarm – Body Hammering Australia Tour
events.description: Scottish powerviolence band Endless Swarm brings their ferocious live act to BackDock Arts. Expect blast-driven hardcore, grind-scarred riffs, and venomous vocals in short, savage bursts, offering an authentic underground music experience.

events.title: Dog Lovers Festival Brisbane 2026
events.description: Queensland's largest dog celebration offers a weekend of meeting hundreds of breeds, shopping for dog brands, and exploring adoption zones. It's a genuinely community-spirited event for dog parents and lovers, fostering natural conversations.

events.title: Brisbane Riverside Social Walk
events.location: Brisbane Riverside (meeting point posted on Meetup)
events.description: Join the Brisbane Riverside Social Walkers for a low-key evening stroll along the river. This recurring community group is perfect for meeting active and curious people in a relaxed, outdoor setting.

events.title: Brisbane Social Sport Group – Wednesday Social
events.description: A recurring social sport meetup for active individuals to connect and play. Attracts a friendly, mixed crowd for fun, low-pressure activities, perfect for naturally meeting new people and getting active.

events.title: Brisbane Boardgamers – Saturday Night
events.description: A long-running community group gathering for an evening of boardgames. It's a low-cost, conversational event that naturally draws curious, analytical, game-loving people of all ages for social interaction and strategic fun.

events.title: Polestar 5 Design & Tech Preview
events.datetime: Tue 12 – Sat 16 May, 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM daily (daily 11am talk)
events.location: Polestar Brisbane, 773 Ann Street, Fortitude Valley
events.description: Explore the Polestar 5 with daily talks on its design, performance, and sustainability, alongside food and drinks. This free event provides a low-key space for design and tech enthusiasts curious about sustainable transport and EV engineering.

events.title: Brisbane Language Exchange – Friday
events.description: A recurring community event to practice languages, meet new people, and learn about different cultures. It fosters conversation and connection among internationally-minded and curious attendees.

events.title: Data Science & Analytics Meetup – Brisbane Friday
events.description: A recurring gathering for data, analytics, and tech-curious people to connect, discuss ideas, and share insights. It's designed to be more conversational than corporate, attracting intellectually engaged professionals and enthusiasts.
